name: time-field
title: Time field
description: A time of day in one field frame: hour and minute spin-button cells that wrap, a day-period cell on a 12-hour clock, a zone affix, optional min/max bounds; the 24-hour "HH:MM" value reaches Base UI Form and FormData.
whenToUse: Use it to type a time of day in parts. For a day from a calendar use Date picker.

parts.name: TimeField
parts.description: A time of day in one field frame: two spin-button cells (three for a 12-hour clock) and a zone affix. Pickup ┌──────┬───┬──────┬─────┐ ┌──────┬───┬──────┬────┬─────┐ │ 14 │ : │ 30 │ CET │ 24-hour │ 02 │ : │ 30 │ PM │ CET │ 12-hour └──────┴───┴──────┴─────┘ └──────┴───┴──────┴────┴─────┘ - Each part is an input with role="spinbutton" (aria-valuenow/min/max/text), so it is announced as a spin button with its value, not as a text box. Tab moves through the parts in reading order. - Arrow Up/Down step and WRAP (23 → 00, 12 → 01, 59 → 00): a clock has no end. Page Up/Down move hours by 6 (3 on a 12-hour clock) and minutes by 10. Home/End go to the first and last value. - Typing: digits only. Hours advance after two digits, or one digit that cannot start a two-digit hour ("7" is 07; on a 12-hour clock "2" is 02). On a 12-hour clock minutes advance to the period the same way. The period takes "a" or "p" (or a letter only one of the locale's names has), and the arrows switch it. Backspace in an empty part returns to the one before. Blur pads ("7" → "07"). - The value is always 24-hour "HH:MM", so changing `hourCycle` never changes what is stored or submitted. On a 12-hour clock the value is complete only once the period is chosen. - Field: the frame, focus edge, ! cell, hatch and messages are Field's. The value reaches Base UI Form (and FormData) through a hidden Field control named `name`; `required` is checked there ("Enter a time"). - RTL: the ! cell and zone follow the page; the time itself stays in clock order (dir="ltr"), with the period where the locale puts it.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: 24: hours 00–23 (default). 12: hours 01–12 and a day-period part (AM/PM, named by `locale`).

props.name: label
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Visible label (visually hidden with layout="cell"). Names the group; each part is named too.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px frame. cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (no border, label visually hidden).

props.name: locale
props.description: Names the day periods and decides whether the period comes before the hours (e.g. "ko", "zh"). Default: the runtime's.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest and latest allowed time, "HH:MM" 24-hour. Arrow keys never step outside them (they wrap to the other bound); a typed time outside them is invalid with `rangeMessage`.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: Arrow keys move minutes by this much (and snap to it). Default 1.

props.name: name
props.description: Form name; the submitted value is "HH:MM", 24-hour (or "" when incomplete).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with "HH:MM" (24-hour) once every part holds a value, and with null when one is cleared.

props.name: periodLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the day-period part (12-hour). Default "AM/PM".

props.name: rangeMessage
props.description: Error for a time outside min/max. Default "Choose a time from {min} to {max}." in the shown clock.

props.name: value
props.description: "HH:MM", 24-hour, whatever the hour cycle shown. null (or "") is no time.

props.name: zone
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Trailing affix cell in the Code voice: a time zone ("CET"), "local".
